{{recipesummary|category=Casserole recipes|servings=5|time=45 minutes|difficulty=1}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Fish|Fish]] | [[Cookbook:Pasta|Pasta]]

==Ingredients==
* 2 cans (drained) or pouches (12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] each) [[Cookbook:Tuna|tuna]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 4 cups hot, cooked [[Cookbook:Noodle|medium egg noodles]]
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Peas|frozen peas]]
* 2 cans (21 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) condensed cream of [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushroom]] [[Cookbook:Soup|soup]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] dry [[Cookbook:Bread Crumbs|bread crumbs]]
* 1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:Butter|melted butter]]
* 1–2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Onion|dried minced onion]] (onion)
* ¼–1 teaspoon Texas Pete or other [[Cookbook:Hot Sauce|hot sauce]] (optional)
* 3–4 ounces [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]], shredded or sliced to cover casserole
==Procedure==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|400°F]].
# Shred tuna and stir into 3-[[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] [[Cookbook:Pots and Pans|casserole]] with milk, noodles, peas, and soup. Add onions and hot sauce if desired.
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] until hot, about 25–30 minutes.
# Remove from oven, and top with bread crumbs mixed with butter or with cheese.
# Bake another 5 minutes.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
*Replace half of mushroom soup with cream of celery.
*Try replacing breadcrumbs with crushed potato chips.
